app.name: Modern Wiifare
app.short_description: MW2 multiplayer maps on the Wii (fly-through)
app.long_description: Loads sd:/modernwiifare/maps/mp_rust.wpk (made with mwf-convert from your own copy of the game) and flies through it. Main stick move, C-stick look, L/R down/up, B fast, Y next spawn, START exits. A solid red screen means the pack was not found on the SD card.
